textOurhistory: Born en 2025, AbadengoGames is an online store born out of a passion for collecting and the thrill of opening packs to discover new cards. Our mission is to provide an accessible and exciting experience for fans of trading cards and collectibles, helping them find their favorite products at fair prices.
